hints.title: Distinct Sum Accounting
hints.text: Track the contribution of each distinct value in the current window using element frequency counts.

hints.title: Two Scanning Pointers
hints.text: Expand the right boundary, adding value to distinct_sum only when its frequency increases from 0 to 1.

hints.title: Shrink Left Boundary
hints.text: Whenever distinct_sum >= k, record the window size and shrink from the left, subtracting value from distinct_sum when its frequency drops to 0.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def minSubarrayLen(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        counts = defaultdict(int)
        cur_sum = 0
        left = 0
        min_len = float('inf')
        
        for right, x in enumerate(nums):
            if counts[x] == 0:
                cur_sum += x
            counts[x] += 1
            
            while cur_sum >= k and left <= right:
                min_len = min(min_len, right - left + 1)
                out = nums[left]
                counts[out] -= 1
                if counts[out] == 0:
                    cur_sum -= out
                left += 1
        
        return min_len if min_len != float('inf') else -1
```

complexity.notes: Each element enters and leaves the window at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all O(n^2) subarrays takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency dictionary uses O(distinct elements) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects dynamic window expansion and shrinkage with distinct sum tracking.
